description.value: The study investigated regional gray matter volume differences between otherwise healthy chronic cigarette smokers and matched non-smoking control subjects using whole-brain voxel-based morphometry.

spans.text: To further investigate the effects of chronic cigarette smoking on structural brain changes, we applied whole-brain voxel-based morphometry (VBM) to quantify regional gray matter volume between 44 otherwise healthy chronic cigarette smokers and 44 matched non-smoking control subjects.

description.value: A cross-sectional observational comparison of smokers and non-smokers recruited from the local community.

spans.text: A total of 44 smokers and 44 non-smokers, 19–39 years of age were recruited from local community by advertisements.

definition.value: gray matter volume was lower in the smokers than in the non-smokers group

spans.text: In the VBM analysis, gray matter volume was lower in the smokers that in the non-smokers group in the left thalamus, left medial frontal cortex (Brodmann area 10) and left anterior cingulated (see Fig. 1 and Table 1 ).

value: The present study found that chronic cigarette smoking subjects had reduced gray matter volume in the left thalamus, left medial frontal cortex and left anterior cingulated.
In summary, the findings of this study demonstrated significant gray matter volume reduction in the left thalamus, medial frontal cortex and anterior cingulate in chronic cigarette smokers.

source_definition.value: Smoking group, represented by the smokers and non-smokers study groups.

spans.text: To examine differences in regional gray matter volume between groups, a voxel-wise two-sample t -test analysis in SPM5 and total gray matter volume was set as covariates.
total gray matter volume was set as covariates

source_definition.value: Total gray matter volume entered as a covariate to remove its effects and allow inference about regional gray matter volume differences.

spans.text: The effects of total gray matter (GM) volume were removed to allow inferences about regional differences in volume.

model_settings.value: Voxel-wise two-sample t-test in SPM5 with total gray matter volume as a covariate; absolute threshold mask 0.1; initial extent threshold 100 voxels; voxel-level uncorrected P < 0.001.

spans.text: An initial threshold of 100 voxels (a voxel size equal to 1 mm 3 ) or greater surviving an uncorrected threshold of P < 0.001 was set.

description.value: Structural data were processed using VBM5.1 and SPM5; tissue segmentation, bias correction, spatial normalization, modulation, and smoothing were performed.

spans.text: The VBM toolbox combines tissue segmentation, bias correction and spatial normalization into a unified model.
Modulated gray matter images were smoothed with a 12 mm full width at half maximum (FWHM) Gaussian kernel for statistical analyses.
